item.title: ‘threeASFOUR: Full Circle’ Review: Sean Ono Lennon’s Bittersweet Portrait Of Fashion, Idealism & The Cost Of Creativity
item.description: What happens when extraordinary talent, boundless imagination, and an uncompromising artistic vision aren’t enough to survive? That’s the bittersweet question at the heart of “threeASFOUR: Full Circle,” a sympathetic, surprisingly poignant documentary from Sean Ono Lennon about three avant-garde fashion designers whose greatest strengths may also be their greatest vulnerabilities. For more than 25 years, the collective has pushed the boundaries of fashion, earning museum exhibitions, prestigious awards, and celebrity admirers.
